title: Robust Decentralized Federated Distillation via Multi-Modality Knowledge Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2609.07230v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper propose a robust decentralized federated distillation method that enables clients with heterogeneous models to collaborate through predictions on shared unlabeled public data. In the proposed method, each client first evaluates the received predictions in three modalities of class prediction, boundary decision, and prediction correlation. It then filters unreliable clients, assigns reliability-based weights to the retained clients, and constructs a teacher for each type of knowledge. Finally, the corresponding distillation gradients are validated using a supervised gradient computed from private data. Conflicting prediction and boundary gradients are removed, and conflicting relation gradients are suppressed before the final model update. We prove the convergence of the proposed method by showing stable local optimization for honest clients under Byzantine distillation. Particularly, we show that our method ensures a bounded B

translated_title: 基于多模态知识协作的鲁棒去中心化联邦蒸馏
translated_abstract: 本文提出一种鲁棒的去中心化联邦蒸馏方法，使具有异构模型的客户端能够通过在共享的无标签公共数据上的预测进行协作。在所提出的方法中，每个客户端首先从类别预测、边界决策和预测相关性三种模态评估接收到的预测，然后过滤掉不可靠的客户端，为保留的客户端分配基于可靠性的权重，并为每种类型的知识构建一个教师模型。最后，使用由私有数据计算得到的监督梯度对相应的蒸馏梯度进行验证：冲突的预测梯度和边界梯度被移除，冲突的关系梯度在最终模型更新前被抑制。我们通过证明诚实客户端在拜占庭蒸馏下能够实现稳定的局部优化，证明了所提方法的收敛性。特别地，我们展示了我们的方法能确保有界的...（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于多模态知识协作的鲁棒去中心化联邦蒸馏方法，通过对类别预测、边界决策和预测相关性三种模态的评估、过滤不可靠客户端、并利用私有数据的监督梯度验证蒸馏梯度来抵御拜占庭攻击，同时证明了方法的收敛性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a robust decentralized federated distillation method via multi-modality knowledge collaboration, which defends against Byzantine attacks by evaluating predictions in three modalities, filtering unreliable clients, and validating distillation gradients with supervised gradients computed from private data, with proven convergence guarantees.
